info.name: Task1 API Collection
info.description:
# Mechiee API Collection

API Collection for Mechiee Two Wheeler Service Platform Assignment.

This collection contains endpoints for:

- Services Management
    
- Mechanics Dashboard
    
- Booking Creation
    
- Booking History
    

Features:

- Automatic mechanic assignment
    
- Waitlisting when all mechanics are busy
    
- Booking tracking

request.description:
Returns all available bike services.

Method: GET

Endpoint:  
[http://localhost:5000/api/services](http://localhost:5000/api/services)

Response:  
Returns a list of services with:

- Service Name
    
- Description
    
- Price
    

Response Example:  
\[  
{  
"_id": "66a...",  
"name": "Standard Service",  
"price": 499  
},  
{  
"_id": "66b...",  
"name": "Premium Service",  
"price": 999  
}  
\]EndFragment

Returns all mechanics and their current workload.

Method: GET

Endpoint:  
GET /api/mechanics

Response Example:

\[  
{  
"_id": "66a...",  
"name": "Mechanic A",  
"activeBookingCount": 2  
},  
{  
"_id": "66b...",  
"name": "Mechanic B",  
"activeBookingCount": 1  
}  
\]

Creates a new service booking.

Method: POST

Endpoint:  
POST /api/bookings

Request Body:

{  
"customerName": "Priya",  
"bikeModel": "Activa",  
"serviceId": "SERVICE_ID"  
}

Business Rules:

- Booking is assigned to the mechanic with the lowest workload.
    
- Each mechanic can handle a maximum of 3 active bookings.
    
- If all mechanics are at capacity, the booking is added to the waitlist.
    

Success Response:

{  
"success": true,  
"status": "CONFIRMED",  
"message": "Booking created successfully"  
}

Waitlisted Response:

{  
"success": true,  
"status": "WAITLISTED",  
"message": "Booking waitlisted"  
}
